findings.text: The head arm row states the run was on all_debug host 98dci4-clu-3144 with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, but the log it cites, scoped-gate-1795099734450658310.log, records only revision, host, tree, command and EXIT=0: no partition and no job id, and its .scheduler sidecar is empty. The SLURM_JOB_ID=unset line inside that log is the command's own env -u printf, which prints unset whatever the environment held, so it evidences nothing. The partition clause therefore rests on prose; the only support for a submitted job is that the gate host differs from the allocation node 98dci4-clu-3026.

The importing-files arm is recorded as prose in evidence_inputs plus two log paths in test_logs, not as the inline JSON carrying full 40-character revisions that the node's done_when names. Its base arm ran in a scratch tree named on logs/importers-base.log:2 (/tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261118T063059166311-qwnw-red-file-death-row-reads-any-final-record/base-arm-J8d2Ez), yet the manifest records no measurement_module and no measurement_cwd and that log carries no module.__file__ line, so nothing in the receipt shows the base arm imported the extracted revision rather than a shared checkout; the equal 2 failed / 98 passed counts on both arms are the only cross-check, and they would be unchanged if both arms had imported one tree.

item_verdicts.call_sites: The reading reaches production through recovery_watch.py:1457 (the watch snapshot), recovery_repair_dispatch.py:398, resumption.py:363-366 and the re-export at recovery.py:348; the changed offset is consumed only at recovery_wait.py:1659-1662 into _appended_lines and in the scan memo tuple, where a smaller offset costs a wider re-read and nothing else.
item_verdicts.diff: Read both commits against 7c481b65: 45a439059b drops the pre-loop _last_newline_offset(handle, size) call from _tail_record_type and takes the covered offset from the first chunk the loop already reads (reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py, 15 added and 4 removed, one module), and 1a48f7079c adds the 94-line evidence fragment; no test file and no other module changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: The measure asks for the file green at head as a job with SLURM_JOB_ID unset and its output on shared storage, each cause with a product-or-test verdict, no assertion deleted or weakened, and importing arms as inline JSON with 40-character revisions; the manifest carries the green head run on shared storage, the product-wrong verdict and untouched tests, but the importing pair is prose plus logs/importers-*.log rather than inline JSON and the all_debug clause is carried by no log line.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to make tests/test_death_row_reads_any_final_record.py pass in full; that file is untouched by the diff and the head gate scoped-gate-1795099734450658310.log records 5 passed EXIT=0 at 45a439059b, against 1 failed and 4 passed EXIT=1 at 7c481b65 in negative-control-base-red.log, so the named file is green at head and the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read in full at the run directory: it names commits 45a439059b and 1a48f7079c, the head gate with 5 passed and EXIT=0, the base red run with 1 failed and the id test_the_common_small_record_path_reads_one_window_not_the_stream, the declared suite arms at 7c481b65 and 1a48f7079c (58 passed each in their logs), the importing pair at 2 failed and 98 passed each, and two out-of-scope ids red at both revisions.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared scope is reckon, tests, docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround and its fragment path, and docs/figures/...; the delivered diff is exactly reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py and docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-death-row-reads-any-final-record.html, both inside, with tests declared and left untouched because the cause was the product.
